title: INVESTIGATING ANNOTATOR BIAS IN LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FOR HATE SPEECH DETECTION

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to act as 'Female' versus 'Not Female' annotators and measuring the mismatch percentages and accuracy differences in binary hate speech classification.

Prompting LLMs to act as 'Asian' vs 'Not Asian' and 'Black' vs 'Not Black' annotators, then comparing the resulting hate speech annotations to evaluate mismatch rates and accuracy compared to human ground truth.
Prompting LLMs to assume 'Muslim' versus 'Not Muslim' annotator personas and calculating the divergence (mismatch) and accuracy in their hate speech labeling decisions.
Prompting LLMs to adopt 'Mental Disability'/'Physical Disability' versus 'No Disability' personas and analyzing the discrepancies and accuracy in their classification of hate speech.
